name: Matías Ramón Mella
role: Dominican revolutionary; 7th Vice President of the Dominican Republic from 1863–1864
contribution: A Dominican revolutionary, politician, and military general during the Dominican War of Independence.
legacy: This person was a member of La Trinitaria, a secret society founded in 1838 to organize resistance to Haitian rule in the eastern part of Hispaniola

checks.lead: Matías Ramón Mella Castillo (25 February, 1816 – 4 June, 1864), known as Ramón Mella, was a Dominican revolutionary, politician, and military general during the Dominican War of Independence. He is known for being one of the three principal leaders of the independence movement, together with Juan Pablo Duarte and Francisco del Rosario Sánchez, and is one of the founding figures of the Dominican Republic.
